cards.mood: The piece opens with an atmospheric and slightly ominous tension, establishing a sense of impending force.
cards.palette: A grand piano playing minor-key chord progressions serves as the harmonic backbone throughout the track, providing a melancholic yet sturdy foundation from the Intro to the Outro.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Walking through the shadows where the heavy stones collide
Tracing every heartbeat where the hidden secrets hide
The thunder is a hammer hitting iron in the sky
Watching every mountain peak reach upward high
I felt the ground tremble, the clouds began to gray
Chasing every ghost of the doubts that stayed the way
Now the spark is growing, a fire in the bone
Carving out a kingdom on a path I walk alone
[Chorus]
Rise above the storm, break the heavy chain
Find the hidden strength inside the pouring rain
Higher than the peaks, deeper than the sea
Claim the crown of light that was meant for me
[Verse]
Every step a conquest, every breath a brand new song
Finding where the weary and the desperate souls belong
The rhythm is a heartbeat, steady, fast, and deep
Promises of glory are the secrets that I keep
No more looking backward at the ghosts of yesterday
Watch the gray horizon turn to gold and vibrant clay
I am the mountain, I am the shifting tide
With the power of the stars burning deep inside
[Chorus]
Rise above the storm, break the heavy chain
Find the hidden strength inside the pouring rain
Higher than the peaks, deeper than the sea
Claim the crown of light that was meant for me
[Bridge]
In the sudden hush, the world begins to fade
Standing in the silence of the choices made
[Chorus]
Rise above the storm, break the heavy chain
Find the hidden strength inside the pouring rain
Higher than the peaks, deeper than the sea
Claim the crown of light that was meant for me
[Outro]
